notes.title: Indie Chaos, Wired Style
notes.content: [p]No, you’re not seeing things. Up to [b]90% off[/b] Wired games on Steam. This isn’t one of those “polite discounts” – this is the kind of sale that makes your wishlist weep and your backlog beg for mercy.[/p][p]For nearly 20 years, we’ve been doing things our way – publishing the weird, the bold, the unforgettable. Games with soul. Games that get under your skin. Games that make you laugh, scream, and sometimes question reality itself. And for one week only, you can snag them for less than the price of your morning coffee.[/p][p]Here’s just a taste of the chaos waiting for you:[/p][list][*][p][b]Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks (-50%)[/b] 🚗💥 – Explosions, orcs, and racing mayhem. With big updates landing in October, now’s the time to jump in.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hotel Architect (-20%)[/b] 🏨 – Build it big, build it tacky, build it [i]yours[/i]. And yes, thanks to this week’s free update, you can finally build in Vegas.[/p][/*][*][p][b]KARMA: The Dark World (-30%)[/b] 👁️ – A paranoid, stylish psychological horror. Xbox players get it next week, but right now PC has the best deal ever.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Martha Is Dead (-70%)[/b] 😱 – Controversial, haunting, and impossible to forget.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deliver Us The Moon (-85%)[/b] 🌙 – Humanity’s last hope is you. Award-winning sci-fi at its lowest price yet.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Arcade Paradise (-75%)[/b] 🕹️ – From dingy laundromat to neon arcade empire. Your 90s dream awaits.[/p][/*][/list][p]…and that’s just scratching the surface.[/p][p]This isn’t just a sale – it’s a love letter to indie madness. Wired doesn’t do ordinary, and neither should you. Grab the games that everyone talks about, the ones that hit differently, the ones that stay with you long after the credits roll.[/p][p]👉 The Wired Productions Publisher Sale is live [b]September 4–11, 2025[/b]. Don’t miss it.[/p]

notes.title: New Publisher and New Content Incoming!
notes.content: [p]Big news from the world of Aaero...[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve always believed in the power of music to transform how players experience games and today we announced a new partnership with long time friends at Indie Publisher [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/WIRED"]Wired Productions[/url]. Really, this feels like coming home, Wired and Mad Fellows have been long time friends, and todays news is just the beginning. As part of our announcement, both Aaero and Aaero2 will join the Wired portfolio, and we're thrilled to reveal that over the last few months we've secretly been working with Wired on ALL NEW Aaero2 tracks! Launching later this year we'll have two brand new Music Packs. One Taking songs from Wired's acclaimed Arcade Paradise and the 2nd pack focusing on music from Lania Kea, a rising start in the Black Razor Records family. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="3_9yDd8-SiI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Although we’re kicking things off with Aaero, a game we have always loved, our partnership is very much looking into the future of where we can take music-based games... and we look forward to sharing more about the future in time![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726650/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726660/Aaero_2__Lania_Kea_Music_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]You can wishlist both new Music packs right now and we'll have some more announcements and details coming soon![/p]
